evidence: Source review against native build 1: this change makes the stop of a Codex, Hermes or Claude backend child finish when one of its own background tasks already died with an error. It adds a small internal helper, end_task, and one except clause in the Claude stop. Routes, request and response payloads, status codes, and the build floor are unchanged. No iOS client call reaches the code that changed. Verification: 45 backend unit tests passed (Codex adapter, Claude SDK, Hermes ACP, Claude cleanup), ruff and mypy on backends/ were clean. The full unit and integration suites were not run for this ticket. No signed-device, TestFlight, or native reconnect checks ran.
